name: Oslo, Flåm and Bergen, Norway
summary: Three bases. Fly into Oslo, take the railway west to Flåm, and leave from Bergen. April can be beautiful, and it is also when many of Norway's great mountain roads and hikes are still shut.
why: Oslo gives the children a real city before the fjord. Flåm is the railway and the water. Bergen is the harbour you fly home from. They will not get Trolltunga, Geiranger by road, or a mild week.
distinctive: A 20-kilometre branch line from a high railway down to a fjord, with a waterfall stop, in a country that is still waking up in April.
weather: Bergen in April is often near 10°C by day and a few degrees at night, and it rains. Snow remains on the mountains. Seasonal pattern.
crowds: April is quiet compared with June and July. Easter week is the Norwegian mountain holiday. Easter 2027 ends on 29 March, so the first days of April can still be odd. Cities are open. Many mountain lodges are not in full summer mode.
natureExperiences: The Flåm Railway and the Kjosfossen stop
A fjord boat if the April service is running
Bergen's harbour and a short funicular
Waterfalls seen from the train, not from a closed mountain road
age6: The train, the boat, the funicular, and the aquarium if you need a wet afternoon. No ridge hikes.
age12: The railway engineering and a map of why the road to Geiranger may be shut.
age14: The same, plus Bergen's wharf history. They may be disappointed if the trip was sold as hiking.
adults: The light on the water and a city you can be in for several days without strain.
gettingAround: Train and boat. Do not build a driving tour around mountain passes. The 2026 Flåm timetable showed fewer April departures than the summer timetable, and it expired in December 2026. The 2027 table is a recheck. Norway drives on the right if you do hire a car for one valley day.
meetingPoint: Oslo on the way in, Bergen on the way out. Bengaluru connects through Europe or the Gulf. Melbourne is the long flight. Do not plan a same-city return unless the fare forces it.
visaAu: Schengen visa-free, EES, ETIAS not yet operating.
disadvantages: April is widely described as an awkward month: ski season ending, hiking season not started, passes shut.
Geiranger by road and Trollstigen are not reliable April plans. A 2026 note put Trollstigen's opening at 27 April that year. That date will move.
Rain in Bergen is part of the purchase.
The dramatic photo of Geiranger is not a promise you can drive there.
uncertainties: Which fjord boats run in April.
Opening dates for mountain roads, which depend on snow.

gain: A true railway-and-fjord journey, quiet and serious.
miss: Pleasant temperatures, open hiking, and the famous mountain roads.

The Schengen consular fee is €90 from age 12 and €45 from age 6 until the 12th birthday. A German mission in India was collecting those fees as ₹9,900 and ₹5,000 on 1 October 2026. The four Indian passports come to about ₹35,000 if the 6-year-old is one of them, or about ₹40,000 if all four holders are 12 or older. The visa-centre charge is extra. Australian passports pay no Schengen visa fee for a short stay.

cost.leftOut: Hotels, meals, trains and international flights are not included.

trip.note: International flights were not published, so they are not inside this. The Schengen visa fee is.
trip.text: A band for seven people and about 13 nights, rounded to the nearest lakh. Not a quote, and not used to order the list. Three rooms, meals for seven, local transport and tickets. The 6-year-old's meals are not discounted. Insurance, bags and shopping are outside it. The columns are Bergen's, from Budget Your Trip on 5 September 2026. Oslo and Flåm can differ.

stretch16: Add a free day in Oslo and a free day in Bergen. Do not add Tromsø.

days.experience: Land and walk the harbour. No museum today.
days.optional: A ferry look at the islands only if everyone is awake
days.highlight: A capital used as a soft landing
days.transfer: Oslo airport to the centre is a train. Long-haul connections are the tiring part. Confirm the 2027 airport train.
days.seasonal: April in the city is cool and often bright. It is not hiking weather.
days.wet: Stay near the hotel and eat.

days.experience: One indoor museum the children can handle, then a free afternoon.
days.optional: The harbour and a bakery. Confirm which museum is actually open in 2027 before you name it.
days.highlight: Ships, Vikings or science, in one dose
days.kids: One museum. The 6-year-old sets the leaving time.
days.transfer: Tram or a short walk. No car.
days.seasonal: The old Viking ship hall has been closed for a new museum. Do not promise that building.

days.experience: A free city day. One park or the opera roof if the walk is open.
days.highlight: A second city day, so Oslo is not just an airport
days.seasonal: This is the spare day before the long train.

days.experience: Train from Oslo toward Myrdal and down the Flåm Railway. This is a travel day.
days.optional: Stay in Flåm rather than doing the branch line as a day trip
days.highlight: The main line across the mountains, then the branch line and Kjosfossen
days.kids: All three. It is a long sit, then a short spectacular ride. Pack food.
days.transfer: Oslo to Myrdal takes most of the day, then about an hour down to Flåm. Confirm the 2027 connection. April 2026 had fewer Flåm departures than summer.
days.seasonal: Works on the Bergen line happen in some years. Read the operator notice.
days.wet: The train is the right place to be.

days.experience: A fjord boat if one is running, or the village and a short valley walk.
days.optional: The Nærøyfjord sailing only if the April schedule exists
days.kids: The boat. A short walk. No cliff path.
days.seasonal: April sailings are thinner than July. Have the village day ready.
days.wet: The boat still goes in rain unless the wind stops it.

days.experience: A free day in the valley.
days.optional: The Flåm church and a bakery
days.kids: A playground or a short flat path.
days.seasonal: Snow above you is scenery, not an invitation.
days.wet: The railway museum exhibit if open, or the hotel.

days.optional: A window seat and nothing else
days.highlight: The main line over the mountains
days.transfer: Several hours. Confirm the pair of trains.
days.seasonal: This is the journey. Do not add a same-day flight.

days.optional: A last funicular if you missed it
days.highlight: Leaving from a city with a real airport
days.transfer: Short hop to the airport, then a European connection.
days.seasonal: Storms delay Bergen flights. The buffer day matters.
